name: File Browser
summary: Upload, download and look at files in a storage folder on your server from the browser.
description: The Apache-2.0 File Browser by the filebrowser project, packaged from a pinned upstream release. It opens behind Automaton sign-in with no second login and keeps its files in its own data volume. Private only. The upstream project is archived (2026-09-01) and gets no more security fixes.

application.description: Upload, download and look at files in a storage folder on your server from the browser.
